subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should a Control UI stop for a selected non-global channel session permanently clear that session’s follow-up and lane queues, rather than only aborting its currently active run?
rationale: This is a user-visible cancellation policy and public Gateway protocol contract; tests can prove the implementation, but cannot determine whether intentionally discarding queued user work is the desired product behavior.

options.title: Approve selected-session queue clearing
options.body: Accept `clearQueued: true` for the Control UI’s selected non-global no-run-ID stop path while retaining legacy queue-preserving behavior for existing RPC and SDK callers.

options.title: Abort active work only
options.body: Remove the Control UI queue-clearing opt-in so stop preserves queued successors, accepting that a successor may begin after the visible run stops.

options.title: Design a distinct queue policy
options.body: Pause this PR and define a separate explicit user action or confirmation for discarding queued session work.

recommendation.title: Approve selected-session queue clearing
recommendation.body: Accept `clearQueued: true` for the Control UI’s selected non-global no-run-ID stop path while retaining legacy queue-preserving behavior for existing RPC and SDK callers.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner boundary governs abort authorization, queue cleanup, and the public `sessions.abort` contract.
